text:
Favorite part? Okay, let's rank them.

The suit is obviously up there. Flight, a few thousand pounds of thrust, and a heads-up display that tells me everything I need to know and a few things I don't, like how many of my decisions JARVIS considers "statistically unwise." Genius, billionaire, playboy, philanthropist is a nice résumé, but nothing beats going Mach 2 over the Pacific just because I can.

But the real answer is the *building*. Anyone can wear a suit. Designing it, breaking it, rebuilding it at 3 a.m. with a cheeseburger in one hand and a blowtorch in the other, that's where the magic happens. Every Mark is a better answer to a question I didn't know I was asking. The fighting is just the product demo.

And yes, being the guy who gets to say "I am Iron Man" in front of a room full of stunned press people. That's a top-three moment. Dramatic exits are an underrated art form.

Next question. Make it a good one. I've got a repulsor to calibrate and a very short attention span.
